label: Articles
description: a/an/the/zero article; der/ein/kein presence and choice

label: Prepositions
description: a single wrong, missing or extra preposition, incl. prepositional verbs

label: Tense
description: wrong tense, aspect, mood or modal choice for the meaning (went vs have gone; Perfekt vs Präteritum; Konjunktiv II)

label: Verb forms
description: right tense, wrongly built: conjugation, irregular forms, participles, infinitive vs gerund, haben/sein auxiliary

label: Agreement
description: subject–verb agreement

label: Plurals & countability
description: singular/plural, plural formation, countable vs uncountable (informations)

label: Pronouns
description: pronoun form, reflexives, relative pronouns (in German, a pronoun in the wrong case is grammar.case)

label: Adjectives & adverbs
description: comparative/superlative forms, adjective vs adverb (quick vs quickly)

label: Word order
description: constituent order: German V2 and verb-final, separable prefixes; English question order, adverb placement

label: Sentence structure
description: fragments, run-ons, missing subject or finite verb, broken conditionals or clause linkage

label: Case
description: wrong case of an article, pronoun or noun for its role or preposition (mit der Mann → mit dem Mann)

label: Noun gender
description: wrong noun gender: the form would be wrong in every case for this noun (das Tisch → der Tisch)

label: Adjective endings
description: adjective declension endings

label: Verb complements
description: missing or extra object or reflexive pronoun for the verb

label: Negation
description: nicht vs kein, position of nicht

label: Other grammar
description: a grammar error that fits no other grammar category

label: Word choice
description: the word itself has the wrong meaning here, incl. false friends

label: Collocations
description: each word is fine but they don't go together, or a fixed phrase is broken (make a photo; eine Entscheidung machen)

label: Word formation
description: wrong derived form or compound (success vs successful)

label: Spelling
description: a misspelled word, incl. umlauts and ß

label: Capitalization
description: German noun capitalization, Sie/Ihnen, English I, proper names

label: Punctuation
description: punctuation that is clearly wrong or changes the reading (required German comma before a subordinate clause)

label: Word boundaries
description: joined vs separate vs hyphenated (alot; everyday vs every day)

label: Formality
description: too informal or too formal for the chosen tone, incl. shorthand where it doesn't fit

label: du / Sie
description: mixed or wrong form of address, wrong greeting or closing for the tone

label: Connectors
description: a linking word that changes the logic (therefore vs however; deshalb vs trotzdem)

label: Reference
description: unclear or wrong reference to something mentioned earlier

label: Other
description: an error that fits nowhere else
